zones.label: VIP
zones.description: VIP seating sits in the center sections facing the BattleBox and is the premium choice when you want a straight-on view and the most upgraded ticket tier.

zones.label: Center View
zones.description: Center View is the Sweet Spot / Our Pick: a strong look into the BattleBox without paying for the highest premium tier.

zones.label: Side View
zones.description: Side View seats give you an angled look across the BattleBox and are a practical choice when price matters more than being centered.

zones.label: Platinum Club
zones.description: Platinum Club is the upgraded club area beside the arena, aimed at guests who want the premium hospitality experience as much as the view.

zones.label: Obstructed View
zones.description: Obstructed View is the budget-focused tier. The angle or arena structure can limit part of the sightline, so choose it primarily when price is the priority.
